svg.title: Where the edges come from during job expansion
svg.desc: ChainAfterLastEntityEvent chains events that touch the same garage asset; OrderAfterJobLeafEvents orders events within one job; tray moves into a bay depend on that bay's last event.
svg.metadata: ["Start: job 0 retrieves the payload on T17 into bay B21, which still holds the empty tray T21. The DAG is empty and last_event_by_entity has no entries.", "Event 0, BayTransition B21 -> TO_RETRIEVE. ChainAfterLastEntityEvent finds no earlier B21 event and OrderAfterJobLeafEvents finds no earlier leaf of job 0, so no edge is added. last_event_by_entity[B21] = 0.", "Event 1 moves T21 out of the bay (destination still open). OrderAfterJobLeafEvents: event 0 is a leaf of job 0, so 0 -> 1. last_event_by_entity[T21] = 1.", "Event 2 moves T17 into B21. OrderAfterJobLeafEvents: the only job-0 leaf is now event 1, so 1 -> 2. OrderAfterBayAndChargerEvents: the destination is a bay, so the move waits for the bay's last event: 0 -> 2.", "Event 3, BayTransition B21 -> PROCESS_RETRIEVE. ChainAfterLastEntityEvent chains it to B21's last event (0 -> 3); OrderAfterJobLeafEvents adds 2 -> 3. last_event_by_entity[B21] = 3.", "Job 1 reparks T21 to P24 (event 4). OrderAfterJobLeafEvents finds no leaf of job 1, so it adds nothing; ChainAfterLastEntityEvent links it to T21's last event: 1 -> 4. That shared tray is the only link between the two jobs."]
